newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cardoso will visit Britain Dec 2-5.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cardoso will visit Britain Dec 2-5.

text.p: Brazil's President Fernando Henrique Cardoso will make a state visit to Britain in early December and stay at Buckingham Palace as a guest of Queen Elizabeth II, a Foreign Ministry official said.
"This will be the president's third visit to the United Kingdom but his first state visit," said the official, who requested anonymity.
The ministry said Cardoso and his wife Ruth would travel to Britain from December 2 through 5.
He said Cardoso's agenda had not been set yet, and it was "premature to talk about agreements" he may sign, but talks would likely focus on bilateral political and economic issues.

"Brazil is trying to attract foreign investment and Britain is considered an important source of investment," he said, adding the visit also will serve to strengthen links with the new British government.
The official said Brazil's first couple had received an invitation by Queen Elizabeth II to stay at Buckingham Palace.

It will be Cardoso's third visit to Britain since he took office on Jan. 1, 1995. Early this year, Cardoso visited London to attend an economic conference. He also attended an international event there in 1996.
